Why: PKA reduces glycinergic inhibition in the dorsal horn
Note: Spinal PGE2 removes glycinergic inhibition through EP2 and PKA phosphorylating GlyR α3. In knee OA the spinal cAMP-PKA pathway is also shown in the other direction, in GABAergic neurons carrying analgesia (Yuan 2021): the colour holds for the neuron drawn.
